Triage: lands in the merged-branch reaper 的作用域(`.github/workflows/merged-branch-reaper.yml` 及其分类脚本)⇒ **`domain:devx`** · `pm:queue` · `Task` · `priority:p3` · `tooling`。

**Task 而非 Bug,p3 而非更高**:卡把自己的边界划得很干净 —— 这是**范围问题,不是「678 个分支是垃圾」的断言**。两件事**明确未测**:这些分支是否已死(只对 `claude/` 做过 PR-state 分类,**没有**对 `copilot/` 做);以及它们是不是 agent 分支(前缀提示 Copilot coding-agent,**未验证**)。

## 交付 = 先测量,再决定是否扩 reaper 作用域

⛔ **不得直接把 `copilot/` 加进 reaper**。第一交付是**用与 `claude/` 相同的仪器**对 678 个 ref 做一次分类:

```
GET /repos/OWNER/REPO/pulls?head=OWNER:BRANCH&state=all   → 读 merged_at
```

⚠️ ⛔ **不得用 `git merge-base --is-ancestor`** —— 卡已给出理由且分诊背书:本仓经队列 squash-merge **会重写提交**,一个完全合并的分支其 tip **正常情况下不是 `main` 的祖先**,该探针会**严重低报**。

分类结果两支:
- 死分支占比可观 ⇒ 带读数提请扩 reaper 作用域(那是独立决定,可能需维护者 —— 删别的工具产生的分支);
- 占比很小 ⇒ 记录读数并关卡,理由是卡自己提的那条:GitHub 的 `delete_branch_on_merge` **实测已启用**(泄漏率 0.07%)⇒ 残余可能本来就小。

## 定级理由

`copilot/` 占全部 remote head 的约 **63%**、是 `claude/` 的两倍 —— 若 `claude/` 的堆积值得一张卡,**比它大一倍的命名空间至少值得一次测量再被静默排除**。但今天**没有任何东西因此坏掉** ⇒ p3。

查重:卡已做,且带对照(同会话的对照词返回了预期命中 ⇒ 空结果是读数)。现存分支卫生卡(#12771 与其两张已关前身)**全部只讲 `claude/` 前缀**,无一提及 `copilot/`。

os-dev-report

Claim: session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV` (domain:devx execution seat, seat post #6023) — R1 wave 8. Measurement card, no repo change. Deliverable below.

## Population

`git -C /home/user/objectstack ls-remote --heads origin`, re-derived (2026-09-02): **678** `copilot/*` heads, matching the card's count exactly. `claude/` is now 384 in the same snapshot.

## Instrument

Same as #12771's classification: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls?head=objectstack-ai:BRANCH&state=all`, defensively filtered to `pr.head.ref === BRANCH` (the same guard PR #13500 added, after measuring that `commits/{sha}/pulls` answers a different question). Never `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, anywhere in this run. All 678 branches got a live `pulls` response (0 errors); tip-commit metadata (`GET /repos/.../commits/SHA`) was also fetched for all 678 (0 errors). Total REST calls this run: approximately 1,382 — 678 (pulls) + 678 (commits) + 16 (paginated `state=all` PR listing, used only for the leak-rate cross-check below) + about 10 misc (issue/PR reads, repo settings, protected-branch list, rate-limit checks). Zero MCP GitHub calls (`mcp_calls: 0`) — everything went through REST with `$GITHUB_TOKEN` per the routing note. Cache: `/tmp/.../scratchpad/copilot-census/cache/{pulls,commits,pr-pages}/` (678 + 678 + 16 JSON files, ~120MB) — every number below is reproducible from there; `classify.py`, `fetch_commits.py`, `fetch_all_copilot_prs.py`, `aggregate.py` are in the same directory for a re-run.

## Bucket table

| bucket | count | % of 678 |
|---|---:|---:|
| MERGED | 575 | 84.8% |
| CLOSED, unmerged | 90 | 13.3% |
| OPEN | 0 | 0.0% |
| NO PR at all | 13 | 1.9% |

This is close to the opposite shape from `claude/`'s #12771 classification (MERGED 33.1% / NO-PR 50.7%-dominant / CLOSED-unmerged 12.8% / OPEN 3.3%). Here almost the entire population already has a resolved PR outcome, and there are zero currently-open PRs against any `copilot/` branch — confirmed independently against the repo's full `state=open` PR list (25 open PRs repo-wide, none with a `copilot/` head).

## Tip-commit age distribution per bucket (days, as of 2026-09-02)

| bucket | n | min | median | max | 7d or less | 30d or less | 90d or less | over 90d |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| MERGED | 575 | 98 | 203 | 227 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 575 |
| CLOSED, unmerged | 90 | 136 | 213 | 227 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 |
| OPEN | 0 | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| NO PR | 13 | 117 | 138 | 204 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 13 |

100% of all 678 branches are over 90 days old. This is a frozen historical population, not an ongoing accumulation. Cross-check: the newest Copilot-authored PR of any state in the whole repo was created 2026-05-27T10:41Z (confirmed by paginating `state=all` PRs #1 through #1600 and filtering to `user.login == 'Copilot'` — see leak-rate section), and the newest of the repo's most-recent 30 PRs (spanning a few hours on 2026-09-02) are 100% `claude/`, zero `copilot/`. Whatever produced this namespace stopped roughly three months ago; it is not growing the way `claude/`'s NO-PR bucket was (123/170 within the trailing 14 days, per #12771).

## Authorship

- **PR author**: 100% — all 665 PR records (across MERGED+CLOSED+OPEN branches) were opened by the same account, `login: "Copilot"`, `type: "Bot"`, backed by the `copilot-swe-agent` GitHub App (`html_url: github.com/apps/copilot-swe-agent`). This closes the card's second open question ("whether they are agent branches at all" — unverified): yes, verified, these are GitHub Copilot coding-agent branches.
- **Tip-commit author** (login on the branch's current head commit): Copilot 616 (90.9%), `hotlong` 55 (8.1%), `huangyiirene` 4 (0.6%), `xuyushun441-sys` 3 (0.4%). So on roughly 1 in 11 branches a human pushed the last commit — most likely continuing or fixing agent work — rather than the agent itself.

## delete_branch_on_merge leak reading

Repo setting: enabled (`GET /repos/.../objectstack` → `delete_branch_on_merge: true`), same as the #12771 finding.

Two different denominators, both computed and reconciled:

1. **Naive framing** (of branches that still exist today, how many are already-merged): 575/678 = 84.8%. This is not directly comparable to the claude/ card's 0.07%, which used a different denominator.
2. **Same framing as #12771's 0.07%** (of all Copilot-authored merged PRs ever, how many still have their head branch on the remote): paginated `pulls?state=all&sort=created&direction=asc` from PR #1 through page 16 (created_at past 2026-06-20, well past the last Copilot activity), collected all `user.login == "Copilot"` PRs — 665 total, exactly matching the 665 found via the branch-scoped method (a clean cross-validation: every Copilot PR that ever existed still has its branch on the remote, and this run's branch enumeration missed none). Of those, 575 merged, and 575 still have their head branch present, so leak rate = 100.00%, vs claude/'s 0.07%.

**Reconciling the two numbers — this is not a copilot-specific behavioral gap.** It's a timing artifact: every Copilot-authored PR in this repo's history was created and merged between 2026-01-18 and 2026-05-27, months before `delete_branch_on_merge` was evidently turned on. The #12771 report's own legacy debt (111 `claude/` branches merged before the toggle, including 33 from 2026-06) and its native-leak measurement window (only 2026-08-20 onward) both point at the same toggle date, sometime after 2026-06 and by 2026-08-20. Copilot's population is 100% pre-toggle legacy with zero post-toggle data points — there has been no Copilot merge since the setting existed to test against. Framed against #12771's own legacy-debt logic (111 pre-toggle `claude/` branches were "one-time debt, not a flow"), this reads the same way: a one-time debt, just proportionally the entire population rather than a third of it, because the underlying activity ended before the cleanup mechanism began.

## Would the reaper (widened) classify these identically?

Read `.github/workflows/merged-branch-reaper.yml` on `origin/main` in full (the script from #12771/PR #13500). Its logic: paginate `repos.listBranches`, filter by prefix, for each branch call `pulls.list({state:'all', head: owner:branch})`, filter `pr.head.ref === branch.name` (defensive, guards the same `commits/{sha}/pulls` trap this run also avoided), then merged/open/closed-unmerged/no-PR, with a `branch.protected` short-circuit and a configurable grace period (default 7 days) since merge.

- **Mechanically, yes** — re-running that exact filter logic against this population (done above) reproduces the same 4 buckets this report shows. None of the 678 `copilot/` branches are protected (`GET /branches?protected=true` → only `main`), so the protected-branch bucket stays empty here too.
- **Grace period is a non-factor** — every MERGED branch is 98+ days past its merge; 100% would clear the default 7-day grace window immediately on a widened first run, none held.
- **Zero branches with more than one PR ever opened** — so the reaper's "newest merge wins" tie-break for reused branch names is never exercised by this population.
- **84 of 665 PR records were drafts**, concentrated almost entirely in CLOSED-unmerged (83 of 90) — most of the "closed, unmerged" bucket is abandoned draft PRs that were never marked ready, not human-reviewed-and-rejected work.
- **The one real shape gap, measured, not hypothetical: the reaper never checks the PR's base ref.** 48 of 575 MERGED branches (8.3%) merged into something other than `main` — mostly another still-existing `copilot/` branch ("stacked" PRs). Walking the chain for all 48: 43 have their base branch itself later merged to `main` via its own PR (content safely lands, just via a 2-hop chain the reaper's flat criterion doesn't need to see); 4 have a base that no longer exists as a branch (mostly `dependabot/*`, not independently re-verified); and 1 — `copilot/check-action-run-status`, based on `copilot/release-new-version-please-work` (PR #124, closed without merging) — is a MERGED PR whose content's path to `main` cannot be confirmed by the PR-state instrument at all. The reaper's current criterion (`merged_at` on the head-ref match, full stop) would flag this branch as safe-to-delete regardless. This is the concrete answer to the card's "shape it does not handle" question: real, but 1 branch in 575 (0.17%) by this measurement, not a systemic hole — and a widened reaper could close it cheaply by also requiring `pr.base.ref === 'main'` (which would then correctly re-bucket the 48 stacked ones as "not directly reapable," even the 43 that are actually fine, trading a handful of false negatives for eliminating the one false positive found here).

## Recommendation for the PM's two exits (not taken here)

Both exits from triage 5478623797 remain live and this is the PM's/maintainer's call:

- **Extend-scope case**: 98.1% of the population (MERGED-past-grace + CLOSED-unmerged) is inert PR-resolved history — the opposite shape from `claude/`'s NO-PR-dominant population, and on population-shape alone a stronger candidate for reaping than the claude/ card was.
- **Small-residue / close-with-reading case**: unlike `claude/`, this is a fully frozen population (0% of 678 branches younger than 90 days, no Copilot activity of any kind since 2026-05-27) — there is no ongoing noise being added to `git ls-remote` or branch selectors the way `claude/`'s live growth was. The urgency that justified #12771 (every session, every ls-remote) does not automatically transfer to a namespace that stopped growing three months ago.
- **A wrinkle for whoever decides "extend"**: this is not simply "run the claude/ reaper on a new prefix." The base-ref gap above means an unmodified widened reaper would delete at least one branch (measured) whose content-in-main isn't confirmed by its own criterion — a real, if small, residual-risk decision, not a config change.

## Open items

- Not measured: whether the 4 branches whose non-main base no longer exists (`dependabot/*` in 3 of 4 cases) had their content safely reach `main` by some other path — would need repo-content diffing, out of scope for a PR-state census.
- Not measured: why Copilot coding-agent activity in this repo stopped after 2026-05-27 (org policy change, tool retirement, etc.) — outside what GitHub's REST API can answer.

## 决策卡 — `copilot/*` 678 个分支的处置(读数已到,出口是维护者的)

PM(devx 执行席,session `session_01WLJQhde67SeTccsmnBVarV`)按分诊 5478623797 的两支出口收读数:测量报告见上一条评论(5511828156),全部数字可从缓存复算。本卡不是「垃圾断言」,是**删别的工具产生的分支**这一动作的授权问题 —— 触人工地板(破坏性动作),⛔ 不代裁。

**读数摘要**:678 个 `copilot/*` 分支 → MERGED 575(84.8%)/ CLOSED 未合并 90(13.3%)/ OPEN 0 / 无 PR 13(1.9%);**100% 超过 90 天**(最新 98 天),整个命名空间自 2026-05-27 起零活动,PR 作者 100% 是 `Copilot` bot(`copilot-swe-agent` app)—— 冻结的历史群体,不是持续堆积。`delete_branch_on_merge` 已启用,但所有 Copilot 合并都早于开关生效,故此处「泄漏率 100%」是开关前的遗留债,不是行为缺口。reaper 的分类器对这 678 个会给出相同分桶,且无一受保护;唯一形状缺口:reaper 不查 PR 的 base —— 575 个 MERGED 里 48 个(8.3%)合进的不是 `main`(多为堆叠 PR),链式回溯 43 个安全、4 个不可验(base 已消失)、**1 个**(`copilot/check-action-run-status`)MERGED ≠ 内容已在 main。

### 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**:678 个死引用占远端 head 的 63%,污染 `ls-remote`/分支选择器/reaper 自身的读数;但今天没有任何东西因此坏掉,也没有新增。需求真实但**一次性**。
- **平台长远合理性**:群体已冻结 ⇒ **常设**把 `copilot/` 加进 reaper 前缀买不到任何东西(没有新分支会来);合理形状是**一次性清扫**,而 reaper 缺的 base 检查(那 48 个)是这次清扫必须带上的守卫,否则会删掉 1 个内容不在 main 的分支。
- **避免 AI 写代码犯错**:删除不可反推(commit 仍经 PR ref 可达,但分支名不可恢复);所以任何清扫必须 (a) 先 dry-run 输出精确清单,(b) 排除 48 个非 main base 中的 4 个不可验 + 1 个具体反例,(c) 由人按清单放行 —— 这正是 reaper 已有的 dry-run/放行形状。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求**:⛔ 不为此新建工具;复用 reaper 的分类器 + 一次 `workflow_dispatch`(或一次性脚本),不扩 reaper 常设作用域,不加新标签新 sweep。

### 选项

- **A(推荐)—— 一次性清扫,复用 reaper 分类器 + base 守卫**:删 MERGED-into-main 527 + CLOSED 未合并 90 + 无 PR 13 ≈ **630**;保留 48 个非 main base 中的 5 个(4 不可验 + 1 反例)待人工看;先 dry-run 清单再放行。不改 reaper 常设前缀。
- **B —— 不动,记录读数关卡**:冻结群体、零增长,容忍 678 个死引用继续存在;成本是每个读 `ls-remote` 的工具永远多看 63% 噪音。
- **C —— 最保守:只删 MERGED-into-main 的 527**,CLOSED 未合并 90 与无 PR 13 留下(它们的内容可能只在分支上)。

推荐 **A**:B 把已量清的债留给下一个测量者;C 留下的 103 个恰是「内容只在分支上」但**四个月无人碰、PR 已关**的那类,与 `claude/` reaper 对同类分支的处置一致(#12771 裁定)。若维护者选 A/C,执行是一张新的 `pm:queue` 卡(dry-run 清单 → 放行 → 删除),⛔ 不在本卡上直接动手。

状态转移(同笔):`pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`;assignee 清空。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — **A: one-off sweep of the `copilot/*` namespace, reusing the reaper's classifier with a base-ref guard; dry-run list first, the maintainer releases it; the reaper's standing scope is not widened** (2026-09-03)

**Provenance.** Ruled by the maintainer (pm@objectstack.ai) in the director seat's live session (`session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`), decision batch #24, 2026-09-03 after 16:30Z. Verbatim reply: 「11977 转维护者，其他同意」 — this card was presented with recommendation **A** (fallback C), so 「其他同意」 adopts A. Ledger: objectstack#12708, batch #24 ledger comment.

**What was ruled.** On the census in comment 5511828156 (678 refs: 575 MERGED / 90 CLOSED-unmerged / 0 OPEN / 13 no-PR; 100% older than 90 days; no Copilot activity since 2026-05-27; all pre-`delete_branch_on_merge` legacy):
- **the reaper's classifier gains a base-ref guard** (`pr.base.ref === 'main'` for the MERGED bucket) with its self-test row — that is the one measured shape gap, and it lands in the standing reaper so the guard is enforced, not remembered;
- **one `workflow_dispatch` dry-run** over the `copilot/` prefix produces the exact deletion list on this card: MERGED-into-main (527) + CLOSED-unmerged (90) + no-PR (13) ≈ 630; the 48 merged-into-non-main branches are excluded by the guard, and the 5 among them the census could not clear (4 unverifiable bases + `copilot/check-action-run-status`) are listed for a human look;
- **the maintainer releases the list with one line on this card**, then the deletion runs once. ⛔ No deletion before that line. ⛔ `copilot/` is not added to the reaper's standing prefixes — the population is frozen, so a standing scope buys nothing.

**Execution.** `domain:devx` lane, S: PR 1 = the base-ref guard + self-test (review, auto-merge, `skip-changeset`); then the dry-run, the list posted here, the maintainer's release, the run. `Fixes #13503` on completion. Clause-②: no.

**State.** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke; `tooling`, `domain:devx`, `priority:p3` kept; unassigned.
